concepts.title: Banach-valued simple function
concepts.description: A measurable function with finitely many values in a Banach space, represented as a finite sum∑_ix_i1_{A_i} with measurable sets A_i.

concepts.title: Bennett exponential-moment bound for a bounded-above variable
concepts.description: If EY=0, Y≤1 and EY²=σ²<∞, then Eexp(aY)≤exp(σ²(eᵃ−1−a)) for a≥0.

concepts.title: Bernoulli distribution
concepts.description: The distribution on {0,1} assigning probability p to 1 and 1−p to 0, for 0≤p≤1.

concepts.title: Bernoulli–Laplace urn chain
concepts.description: Two urns hold fixed numbers of red and black balls; choose one ball uniformly in each urn and swap them. The number of red balls in one urn is a birth-and-death chain.

concepts.title: Bethe free energy of factor-graph marginals
concepts.description: For consistent variable and factor marginals p_x,p_a, the Bethe log-partition functional is ∑_a[H(p_a)+E_{p_a}lnψ_a]−∑_x(d_x−1)H(p_x). On a limiting rooted factor-tree law one uses the corresponding expected local terms, normalized per variable node.

concepts.title: Bethe free-energy limit under local Gibbs decorrelation
concepts.description: For a locally convergent sequence of bounded-degree typed factor models with finite spins and positive weights from a fixed finite family, assume every fixed short-cycle-free event has nonvanishing probability in both ordinary and locally conditioned partition-function-biased models. Let p be a consistent limiting-tree marginal assignment. If average two-variable Gibbs marginals converge in total variation to the corresponding products from p, then limsup n⁻¹ElnZ≤B(p). If the same holds in the locally conditioned partition-function-biased model, the limit equals B(p). Non-reconstruction implies the required decorrelation; uniform tree boundary-influence decay yields equality in both models.

concepts.title: Big O notation
concepts.description: The assertion f=O(g) along a specified limit means |f(x)|≤C|g(x)| near that limit for a fixed finite C. Subscripts specify allowed dependence on fixed parameters. For sequences use x=n→∞.

concepts.title: Moment recursion for binary branching Markov processes
concepts.description: For binary rate-β branching with killed-motion semigroup P_tᴰ, set T_t=e^{βt}P_tᴰ and u_n(t,x)=E_x(∑_{v∈N_t}f(X_v(t)))ⁿ for bounded nonnegative f. Then u_n(t)=T_t(fⁿ)+β∑_{j=1}^{n−1}binomial(n,j)∫₀ᵗT_s[u_j(t−s)u_{n−j}(t−s)]ds. This includes repeated particle labels.

concepts.title: Binary expansion of a nonnegative number
concepts.description: For a nonnegative real number, a representation x=∑_kb_k2ᵏ with digits b_k∈{0,1}; integers use finitely many nonnegative powers, while fractional parts may use a convergent series of negative powers. Dyadic fractional values use the terminating convention when uniqueness is needed.

concepts.title: Binomial distribution
concepts.description: The law of the number of successes in n independent Bernoulli(p) trials: P(B=k)=binom(n,k)p^k(1−p)^(n−k),0≤k≤n.

concepts.title: Binomial theorem
concepts.description: For commuting elements a,b in a commutative ring and integer n≥0, (a+b)ⁿ=∑_{j=0}ⁿbinomial(n,j)aʲb^{n−j}.

concepts.title: Bipartite multigraph
concepts.description: An undirected multigraph whose vertices are partitioned into two classes and whose edges join opposite classes.

concepts.title: Finite birth-and-death chain
concepts.description: A finite Markov chain on {0,…,N} that can move only to neighboring states or remain at its current state; continuous-time versions have jump rates only between neighbors.

concepts.title: Bitwise exclusive-or
concepts.description: For finite binary strings of equal length, exclusive-or adds corresponding digits modulo2. Binary integers are padded with zeros, and binary fractions are aligned by place value before applying the same operation.

concepts.title: Black–Scholes market model
concepts.description: A market with a bank account growing at constant rate r and a stock following geometric Brownian motion with constant volatility σ. Under its pricing measure the stock drift is r.

concepts.title: Bochner integral
concepts.description: For a strongly measurable Banach-valued f with ∫‖f‖<∞, its integral is the norm limit of the integrals of simple approximants converging in the integral of their norm difference; simple functions integrate by∑x_iμ(A_i).

concepts.title: Bochner Lᵖ space
concepts.description: For a Banach space X, Lᵖ(S;X) consists of strongly measurable X-valued functions modulo a.e. equality with finite norm(∫‖f‖ᵖ)¹ᐟᵖ for1≤p<∞; use essential supremum for p=∞.

concepts.title: Gaussian exponential displacement moments for bounded-coefficient diffusions
concepts.description: For a Brownian diffusion with globally bounded drift and diffusion coefficients, for every T>0 there are c,C>0 such that sup_{x,0<t≤T}Eexp(c|X_t^x−x|²/t)≤C.
